instructions: verdict is exactly one of: supported = the unit's words plainly carry the ask's claim, and no other ask in the register fits it better; partial = the unit is on the same subject but states only part of the claim, or fits a sibling ask about equally well; unsupported = the unit is on a different subject, or is an agent/tool/system utterance rather than an operator one, or the claim is not in the text; unresolvable = the text is too truncated, garbled, or ambiguous to judge.
